steps.caption: Open Transactions and the Lumen Harbour Tech transaction.
Section 11: the Leave & licence agreement has two versions.
v2 against v1: one clause added, one removed, one modified — and financial terms changed.
Differs from agreed terms: rent is ₹100 in the document, though nothing at ₹100 was agreed; lock-in is missing.
Clause changes shows each clause before (red) and after.
Section 9, Approvals. The legal approval of v1 was invalidated when v2 arrived — it no longer counts.
A reassessment was opened on v2, assigned to you as legal reviewer. Each approval stores the version's fingerprint.
Decide: ask for changes, with a comment.
Request another approval: choose its category — client commercial, financial, legal, landlord and more — and what it covers.
Messages stating commercial terms need a live client approval of the current position. They are saved as drafts — you send them.
